messages:
Aria P: FYI incoming request from our EU reseller NovaBridge. They're asking for an "initial partner rebate" on first-quarter onboarding usage — want 15% back on first $60k of billings as a channel incentive.
Victor H: Do we have a partner program policy that covers this? If not, Deal Desk required and legal sign-off.
Rina S: They say they committed to a minimum pipeline of $200k ARR in 12 months if we provide the rebate. Need proof of pipeline and partner rep confirmation.
Aria P: partner-bot: NovaBridge partner profile & opportunity links
partner-bot: <https://partners.redwood.com/partner/NovaBridge|NovaBridge profile> · Opportunity P-9876 showing forecasted ARR $225k (attached).
Victor H: Attachments look like sales forecast PDFs. Who owns the forecast validation? Sales ops? Need SR signed commitment or MOU.
Rina S: Also check channel discount stacking rules. We typically don't give rebates on top of channel margin unless there's an authorized incentive. This feels like a special one-off.
Aria P: Customer-facing ask: NovaBridge requests rebate as a credit against billed usage within Q1 invoicing cycle if they hit onboarding milestones by end of Q1. They want a paper MOU from us this week to present to their board.
Victor H: My inclination: approve a conditional rebate up to $9,000 (15% of $60k) provided: 1) MOU signed with clear milestones, 2) Sales ops validates pipeline with two customer references, 3) Rebate paid as a one-time credit after milestones validated. Approver: Victor H.
Rina S: Agree but add clause: rebate clawback if partner fails to deliver agreed pipeline within 6 months. Finance needs GL code PART-REB-01 and approval memo for audit.
Aria P: I'll draft the MOU and loop legal. billing-bot: reserve provisional credit memo slot.
billing-bot: Created placeholder CM-PROV-3001 (status: reserved). GL: PART-REB-01.
Victor H: Please make sure SFDC opportunity has the MOU document attached and tag this thread. Also capture in Deal Desk tracker as "partner rebate precedent".
Rina S: Approved: Conditional partner rebate up to $9k pending signed MOU, pipeline validation, and 6-month clawback. Approver: Rina S.
Aria P: Notifying NovaBridge rep now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
